title: Future Warfare
description:
Cyber Warfare
The world is entering a new era of warfare, with cyber and autonomous weapons taking center stage. These technologies are making militaries faster, smarter, more efficient. But if unchecked, they threaten to destabilize the world.

title: Future Warfare
description:
S01 E03
Gone are the bayonets and pistols, the bows and arrows, the slingshots and stones of past warfare; people have pushed into the outer limits, into a vast frontier, well beyond earth's atmosphere.

title: The Re-Inventors
description:
Flying Machine
See if some of the ideas that were put forward to figure out how to fly could have beat the Wright brothers to the sky.

title: The Re-Inventors
description:
Flying Car
With the advent and spread of airplanes and automobiles in the beginning of the 20th century an idea emerged that a marriage of the two would create the ultimate travel miracle.

title: The Re-Inventors
description:
Incinerating Toilet
As populations have increased over the years, so have the ideas for disposal, removal, and processing regarding waste.

title: Power & Martial Arts
description:
S01 E07 — Boxing - Ruqsana Begum
Ruqsana Begum is a Muay Thai world champion who wants to become the next world champion in boxing; she wants to inspire Muslim women and to make a difference.

title: Power & Martial Arts
description:
S01 E08 — MMA - Nick Hein
Nick Hein is a professional mixed martial artist from Cologne, Germany, who signed with the UFC; his ultimate goal is to become MMA world champion.

title: Power & Martial Arts
description:
S01 E09 — Extreme Martial Arts - Shaina West
Shaina West teaches herself martial arts by watching YouTube while recovering from a motorcycle accident; she posts videos that go viral and "The Samurider" is born.

title: Wonder
description:
S01 E04 — Perception
Saccadic eye movements are characterized as the fast movement of eyes when perceiving motion; plant movement; the language of color; color blindness.

title: Wonder
description:
S01 E05 — Phantoms
The body transfer illusion is the illusion of perceiving another object to be part of your body; the autokinetic effect is the effect caused by subtle movements in our eyes when looking at dark environments; the moon illusion.

title: Wonder
description:
S01 E06 — Art of Illusion
Animation is the process and technique that involves creating the illusion of movement from still drawings and inanimate objects.

title: Science of Sound
description:
S01 E03 — Imagination Soundtrack
Marty Music sits down with Nicole Richard, a neurologic music therapist, and professor from Belmont University to dive into how music makes us move.

title: Science of Sound
description:
S01 E04 — Live Music Vibes
It's easy to love live music; whether jamming with some friends or lost in the crowd at an amazing show, live music really moves; looking into why it feels better than listening to music on even the best home stereo.

title: Science of Sound
description:
S01 E05 — Untrained Ears
Exploring how musicians experience music differently than others, and if recognizing chords or melodies is the only distinction.

title: Combat Forces
description:
Elite Forces
Special Operations forces train to conduct missions that fall outside the norm.

S01 E10 — Porsche Sound Nacht
Go on a journey through the sounds of the most iconic Porsche engines.

Drone technology saves thousands of lives in disaster sites; drones bring vital medications to isolated communities; drone racers.

description:

Law enforcement employs new technology to catch criminals; computer software detects forgery; DNA analysis reveals what a suspect may look like; forensic anthropologists put faces on the unidentified.

Future tech allows archaeologists to look into the ancient past; satellite imaging and 3-D sensing; prehistoric bones; an English king is identified after lying buried for 500 years.

S01 E07 — LOST!
Nick and Laura head deep into the mountains to explore survival techniques from the Survival Training School of California.

title: Survival Science
description:

ATVs have allowed people to penetrate the wilderness like never before, but they've also made the backcountry a bit more dangerous. Laura and Nick rig up some dramatic high-speed tests to see how accidents happen.

description:
S03 E09 — Gravity
The LISA pathfinder has led the way for a space-based gravity wave detector; discussing gravity waves and why they are so hard to detect.

title: The New Frontier
description:
S03 E10 — Interface
Exploring how the Ionosphere, Earth's space interface, impacts radio, GPS and satellites; changing day to night, new satellites explore its mysteries.

title: The New Frontier
description:
The Cryosphere
New satellites are being launched to continue observations of Earth and its oceans and ice caps.

title: Hollywood Weapons: Fact or Fiction?

Terry goes back to paratrooper school and will see how difficult it was for soldiers engaging the enemy while parachuting down to safety on D-Day. He will attempt with 3 different weapons to hit several targets while descending from the air.

description:
S03 E08 — Saving Private Terry
Terry gets to relive part of his military career by attempting the famous sniper shot from "Saving Private Ryan"; Larry and Terry demonstrate how sniper technology has developed over the years and test some great sniper shots.

title: Hollywood Weapons: Fact or Fiction?
description:

Terry channels his inner Dr. Jones and tests a scene from "Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade" containing three different tests, two of which require a tank.

description:

title: Xploration Outer Space

Host Emily Calandrelli, a Harvard scholar and former NASA employee, explores how all the space debris orbiting Earth is tracked and managed.

description:

A look at the challenges of launching a mission to Mars; featuring a talk with the best-selling author of "The Martian," a look at a year-long experiment of living life like a Martian, and the tools needed to survive in space.

S01 E06 — Ribena and Tyrells
Lord Prescott visits the Ribena factory to see how their famous blackcurrant squash is made; in Herefordshire, he explores the Tyrrells crisp factory to learn how a small farm-based business turns homegrown potatoes into gourmet crisps.

title: Breakthrough
description:
S01 E61 — Noah's Ark for the Humans
Human bodies are habitats for bacteria, and many of the microbes are beneficial to us.

title: Breakthrough
description:
S01 E62 — Drones in Space: Mars to Titan
Drones head into outer space with the Mars Helicopter's success paving the way for Dragonfly, a daring future mission to Titan.

title: Xploration Earth 2050
description:
S02 E11 — The Fascinating Future of Growing Food
Changing traditional methods of growing food; aquaponics; food waste.

title: Xploration Earth 2050
description:
S02 E12 — The Future of Water
Using millions of plastic balls to conserve water; figuring out ways for astronauts to survive on Mars; glaciers provide clues about Earth's water supply.

title: Xploration Earth 2050
description:
S02 E13 — The Future of Robotics
A 200-pound robot that is almost as graceful as a dancer; a robot makes deliveries in office buildings; a robot designed to educate toddlers of the future.

title: Space Greed
description:

For the first 50 years of spaceflight, most nations broadly agree that space is common heritage, that it belonged to everybody.
